answer_1.quote: Our method combines Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection and clustering to identify premise‑hypothesis pairs ... generate high‑quality training data using LLMs and Chain‑of‑Thought (CoT) prompting.

answer_2.quote: To assess the semantic alignment between the original hypothesis sentences and the newly generated hypotheses ... we calculate the cosine similarity using Sentence‑BERT embeddings. ... we produced 200 PHL triples for each rule and randomly sampled 40 triples per rule for manual assessment, measuring accuracy based on whether the premise‑hypothesis relationships adhered to their intended rule patterns.
